title: edges report
description: What check edges finds, from check edges -o json: every link that does not land on a component, then the labels no check reads. A link that lands nowhere fails the check; an unread label does not.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always EdgesReport, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

rule.description: What is wrong, an open word. Known words: dangling: an end names nothing on the board, or nothing at all; not_a_component: an end names something that is not a component; unread: a label no selector names, so no check reads its links.

link.description: The link's id; absent for unread, which is about a label.

end.description: Which end: from or to; absent for unread.

id.description: What the end names, or the unread label.

message.description: The same for people; programs never decide by it.
